basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old gamer from Portland, Oregon, who recently discovered the joy of simulation games. I work as a graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to be online during late evenings and weekends. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy spending my free time exploring new games, especially those with complex simulation mechanics. I'm not much into traditional social media, but Reddit has become my go-to platform for engaging with gaming communities. I dislike overly competitive gaming environments and prefer experiences where I can observe and appreciate the unfolding narratives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of simulation games comes from years of playing a variety of games, starting with simpler tycoon games in my teens. I've taught myself about game mechanics and design through a combination of online research, YouTube tutorials, and lots of trial and error. I have no formal education in game design, but my graphic design background helps me appreciate the visual aspects of games.
